instructions: Read the entire Office Open XML Technical Reference for PowerPoint document before starting.
Ensure element ordering in `<p:txBody>` follows the sequence: `<a:bodyPr>`, `<a:lstStyle>`, `<a:p>`.
Add `xml:space='preserve'` to `<a:t>` elements that contain leading or trailing spaces.
Escape unicode characters in ASCII content, for example, convert `"` to `“`.
Add images to `ppt/media/`, reference them in slide XML, and set their dimensions to fit slide bounds.
Update `ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels` for each slide's resources.
Add `dirty="0"` to `<a:rPr>` and `<a:endParaRPr>` elements to indicate a clean state.
When creating a text box or shape with text, include the `<p:sp>` structure with `<p:nvSpPr>`, `<p:spPr>`, and `<p:txBody>` elements as specified.
For text formatting, use `<a:rPr>` attributes: set `b="1"` for bold, `i="1"` for italic, `u="sng"` for underline, and include `<a:highlight>` with `<a:srgbClr val="FFFF00">` for highlighting.
For font and size, set `sz` (e.g., `2400` for 24pt) and `typeface` (e.g., `Arial`) attributes on `<a:rPr>`, and include `<a:solidFill>` with `<a:srgbClr>` for color.
For complete formatting, include `lang="en-US"`, `sz`, `b`, and `dirty="0"` attributes on `<a:rPr>` along with `<a:solidFill>`.
For bullet lists, use `<a:pPr lvl="0">` with `<a:buChar char="•"/>`.
For numbered lists, use `<a:pPr lvl="0">` with `<a:buAutoNum type="arabicPeriod"/>`.
For second-level indents, use `<a:pPr lvl="1">` with `<a:buChar char="•"/>`.
For shapes, use `<a:prstGeom prst="rect">` for rectangles, `prst="roundRect"` for rounded rectangles, and `prst="ellipse"` for circles/ellipses, including `<a:avLst/>`.
For images, include `<p:pic>` with `<p:nvPicPr>`, `<p:blipFill>` referencing the image via `r:embed`, and `<p:spPr>` with `<a:xfrm>` for positioning and sizing.
For tables, use `<p:graphicFrame>` with `<a:graphic>` and `<a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/table">`, including `<a:tbl>`, `<a:tblGrid>`, and `<a:tr>` elements.
For slide layouts, use `<p:ph type="ctrTitle"/>` for centered titles, `type="subTitle" idx="1"` for subtitles, `type="title"` for slide titles, and `type="body" idx="1"` for content bodies.
When adding content, update `ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels` with relationships for slides and slide masters.
When adding content, update `ppt/slides/_rels/slide1.xml.rels` with relationships for slide layouts and images.
When adding content, update `[Content_Types].xml` with Default extensions for image types (e.g., `png`, `jpg`) and Override for slide parts.
When adding content, update `ppt/presentation.xml` with `<p:sldId>` entries in `<p:sldIdLst>`.
When adding content, update `docProps/app.xml` with slide count and statistics like `<Slides>`, `<Paragraphs>`, and `<Words>`.
When adding a new slide to the end of the presentation, create the slide file `ppt/slides/slideN.xml`.
When adding a new slide, update `[Content_Types].xml` with an Override for the new slide.
When adding a new slide, update `ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels` with a relationship for the new slide.
When adding a new slide, update `ppt/presentation.xml` by adding a slide ID to `<p:sldIdLst>`.
When adding a new slide, create slide relationships in `ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels` if needed.
When adding a new slide, update `docProps/app.xml` by incrementing the slide count and updating statistics if present.
When duplicating a slide, copy the source slide XML file with a new name.
When duplicating a slide, update all IDs in the new slide to be unique.
When duplicating a slide, follow the 'Adding a New Slide' steps.
When duplicating a slide, remove or update any notes slide references in `_rels` files.
When duplicating a slide, remove references to unused media files.
When reordering slides, update `ppt/presentation.xml` by reordering `<p:sldId>` elements in `<p:sldIdLst>`.
When reordering slides, keep slide IDs and relationship IDs unchanged.
When deleting a slide, remove the `<p:sldId>` entry from `ppt/presentation.xml`.
When deleting a slide, delete the relationship from `ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels`.
When deleting a slide, delete the Override entry from `[Content_Types].xml`.
When deleting a slide, delete the files `ppt/slides/slideN.xml` and `ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels`.
When deleting a slide, update `docProps/app.xml` by decrementing the slide count and updating statistics.
When deleting a slide, remove orphaned images from `ppt/media/`.
When deleting a slide, do not renumber remaining slides; keep their original IDs and filenames.

Avoid common errors: escape unicode characters in ASCII content, add images to `ppt/media/` and update relationship files, omit bullets from list headers, use valid hexadecimal values for UUIDs, and check all themes in the `theme` directory for colors.
Before packing, clean unused resources by removing unreferenced media, fonts, and notes directories.
Before packing, fix `Content_Types.xml` to declare ALL slides, layouts, and themes present in the package.
Before packing, fix relationship IDs by removing font embed references if not using embedded fonts.
Before packing, remove broken references by checking all `_rels` files for references to deleted resources.

Avoid common template duplication pitfalls: ensure multiple slides do not reference the same notes slide after duplication, remove image/media references from template slides that no longer exist, remove font embedding references when fonts aren't included, include missing slideLayout declarations for layouts 12-25, and note that the docProps directory may not unpack (this is optional).
